Update: September CPI: why 0.6% and 3.7% answer different questions

September CPI retrospective: the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics' October 14, 2026 release has monthly and annual readings.

What to watch: Reading the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics' October 14, 2026 release on September CPI retrospectively raises a separate question: what did contemporaneous market prices show? A claim about reception would need dated price evidence; a surprise claim would need a dated expectation. The CPI readings alone cannot supply either conclusion.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/september-cpi-why-06-and-37-answer

Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.
